unifyCodexHistory.title: Unified Codex session history

When enabled, the official subscription and third-party providers share one session history list. Note: resuming an old session across providers may fail because its encrypted_content reasoning cannot be decrypted by another backend.

autoSync.message:
When auto sync is enabled, every database change will be automatically uploaded to the WebDAV server.

This may result in significant network traffic. Please ensure your network and WebDAV service can handle frequent data transfers.

commonConfig.title: About Common Config
commonConfig.message:
The "Common Config Snippet" lets you share plugins, environment variables, and other settings across different providers — so they won't be lost when you switch.

How to use:
① Edit a provider → click "Edit Common Config" → "Extract from Editor"
② When creating a new provider, check "Apply Common Config" (enabled by default)

If you've newly installed plugins or hooks, re-extract the common config to keep them in sync.

agentTooltip.sisyphus: Main orchestrator responsible for task planning, delegation and parallel execution. Uses extended thinking (32k budget) and drives workflows through TODO lists to ensure task completion.
agentTooltip.atlas: Main orchestrator (holds TODO list) responsible for task distribution and coordination during execution phase. Delegates to specialized agents rather than completing all work directly.
agentTooltip.prometheus: Strategic planner that collects requirements through interview mode and creates detailed work plans. Can only read/write Markdown files in .sisyphus/ directory, never writes code directly.
agentTooltip.hephaestus: Autonomous deep worker ("legitimate craftsman") inspired by AmpCode deep mode. Goal-oriented execution that launches 2-5 explore/librarian agents in parallel for research before taking action.
agentTooltip.oracle: Architecture decision and debugging advisor. Read-only consulting agent providing excellent logical reasoning and deep analysis. Cannot write files or delegate tasks.
agentTooltip.librarian: Multi-repository analysis and documentation retrieval expert. Deeply understands codebases and provides evidence-based answers. Excels at finding official documentation and open-source implementation examples.
agentTooltip.explore: Fast codebase exploration and context grep expert. Uses lightweight models for high-speed search. The scout for understanding code structure.
agentTooltip.multimodalLooker: Visual content expert that analyzes PDFs, images, charts and other non-text media, extracting information and insights from them.
agentTooltip.metis: Plan consultant that performs pre-analysis before planning. Identifies hidden intents, ambiguities and AI failure points to prevent over-engineering.
agentTooltip.momus: Plan reviewer that validates plan clarity, verifiability and completeness with high precision. Rejects and requests revisions until plans are perfect.
agentTooltip.sisyphusJunior: Category-generated executor, automatically created via category parameters. Focuses on executing assigned tasks and cannot re-delegate, preventing infinite delegation loops.

categoryTooltip.visualEngineering: Frontend and visual engineering category for UI/UX design, styling, animation and interface implementation. Defaults to Gemini 3.6 Flash model.
categoryTooltip.ultrabrain: Deep logical reasoning category for complex architectural decisions requiring extensive analysis. Defaults to GPT-5.3 Codex ultra-high reasoning variant.
categoryTooltip.deep: Deep autonomous problem-solving category with goal-oriented execution. Conducts thorough research before action, suitable for difficult problems requiring deep understanding.
categoryTooltip.artistry: Highly creative and artistic task category that inspires novel ideas and creative solutions. Defaults to Gemini 3.6 Flash high variant.
categoryTooltip.quick: Lightweight task category for single-file modifications, typo fixes, and simple adjustments. Defaults to Claude Haiku 4.5 fast model.

commandLists.title: Shell command lists
commandLists.description: Whitelists can mark only ordinary commands classified as literal unknown as low risk; blacklists add warnings without blocking execution.
commandLists.whitelistHint: Whitelists apply only to ordinary commands classified as literal unknown. They do not change known script, network, mutation or privilege classes, or confer trusted identity.
commandLists.blacklistProgramHint: Program blacklists match the last path component (basename) of a complete literal executable token. For example, whoami covers /usr/bin/whoami and ./whoami, including all arguments/subcommands. Dynamic executable tokens are not resolved.
commandLists.whitelistProgramHint: Program whitelists still require an exact executable token match: hostinfo does not trust /usr/bin/hostinfo or ./hostinfo. Whitelists do not exempt known risks or confer trusted identity.
commandLists.segmentedWhitelistHint: Whitelist program / prefix matches each segment separately and affects only matching ordinary unknown segments, never other segments.
commandLists.singleSegmentWhitelistHint: Whitelist exact / keyword / regex applies only to a single ordinary unknown segment; a whole-command match cannot exempt other segments in a compound command.
commandLists.summaryHint: This is a command summary, not the original, and complete sanitization is not guaranteed. Re-enter a verified complete command for exact matching; redacted or truncated summaries cannot be saved as exact entries.
commandLists.suggestionHint: Prefill is only a command/subcommand suggestion from the summary. Check its scope; an unknown program is not necessarily safe or trusted.
commandLists.confirmScope: I have checked the pattern and its scope
commandLists.conflictHint: This may overlap an enabled entry in the other list. Blacklists and dangerous classifications take precedence; whitelists cannot override risk. Check advanced-pattern overlap with the summary preview.
commandLists.previewHint: Previews up to 20 historical command summaries as a conservative literal estimate, which may underestimate Program blacklist path matches. This is not an exact runtime replay, a guarantee of matching the original, or proof of command safety.
commandLists.previewFailed: Validation or preview failed. Check the regex and input, then retry.
commandLists.regexValidationRequired: Regex entries require backend validation before saving; changing input invalidates validation.
commandLists.noPreview: No summaries to preview; pattern validation passed.
commandLists.exactSummaryBlocked: Redaction or truncation markers detected. Re-enter the verified complete command.
commandLists.programInvalid: A program name cannot contain spaces; use prefix matching for subcommands.
commandLists.mutationFailed: Save or delete failed, possibly due to a revision conflict. A list refresh was requested; close and reopen the latest entry. Nothing is overwritten automatically.
commandLists.loadFailed: Command lists could not be loaded. Refresh before editing.
commandLists.empty: No command entries yet. Add an ordinary unknown command whose scope you have verified.
commandLists.deleteHint: Deletion uses the current revision; revision conflicts prevent deletion. Historical records are unchanged.

scope.prefix: Matches this command-token prefix and subsequent arguments with no path normalization. Avoid using only a broad program name.
scope.program: Matches all arguments/subcommands of this executable. This broader scope does not mean the program is trusted or safe.
scope.exact: Matches only the complete command you explicitly enter and verify. A summary is not the original.
scope.keyword: Keyword matching can be broad. Whitelists apply only to a single ordinary unknown segment and cannot exempt other segments.
scope.regex: Uses backend regex semantics. Validate before saving; preview matches represent historical summaries only.

certificate.purpose: Allows the local gateway to decrypt official Qoder requests for security checks. Limited to localhost/127.0.0.1; other apps reading your user keychain may also trust it. Exiting VaryAI restores Qoder configuration and keeps the certificate for reuse. Clear or rebuild it here.
